messages:
zoe: Quick sync: planning FK backfill (orders.customer_id -> customers.id) tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. goal: zero table locks, minimal replication lag. please ack.
arpan: ack. we should pin webapp to v3.5.0-release and freeze unrelated deploys.
zoe: deploybot, schedule job orders-fk-backfill-2300 for 2026-03-22T23:05:00Z. canary 3% for 15m then ramp to 100% over 20m.
deploybot: @zoe scheduled orders-fk-backfill-2300 at 2026-03-22T23:05:00Z. Canary 03% 15m then ramp. Will post start/finish notes.
arpan: abort conditions: any shard lock >3m OR replication lag >90s sustained for 2 checks OR canary error rate >5%. workers use shard leases (redis TTL=4m).
zoe: rollback shortplay: 1) feature flag off (orders_fk_backfill) 2) pin webapp back to v3.4.9 3) run revert script if partial writes. revert snippet below for quick copy.
zoe: ```
-- revert snippet
UPDATE orders SET customer_id = prev_customer_id WHERE backfill_job = 'orders-fk-backfill-2300' AND applied=true;
```
arpan: monitoring query to watch long updates: ```
SELECT pid, now()-query_start AS dur, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%UPDATE orders%' ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 5;
```
oncall-bot: If replication lag > 90s for 2 checks, paging @arpan.
zoe: I'll be in channel from 22:50-00:45 UTC. posting T-15m checklist then.
arpan: good. ensured scheduler pinned to commit ae12f3 to avoid worker pool changes.
zoe: final: no objections, proceeding with scheduled window. :white_check_mark:
